The Opportunity

Adobe Mix Modeler (AMM) is redefining how enterprises measure, plan, and optimize marketing investment by combining advanced modeling with business user focused experiences. The solution helps organizations move beyond fragmented attribution toward comprehensive, trustworthy insights that guide budget allocation, forecasting, and decision-making across channels and marketing teams.

As Principal Product Manager, AI Measurement in Adobe Mix Modeler, own core areas of AMM’s roadmap inclusive of researching, incubating, and delivering AI-powered capabilities that help marketers and analysts understand what’s working, predict outcomes, and confidently act on insights.

Your areas of responsibility will be especially focused on AI based marketing measurement capabilities. Depending on a given project, you could also influence data ingestion/mapping, scenario planning, user experience and various internal and external integrations. You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of these features; from discovering customer problems, establishing business opportunity, collaborating x-functionally to make your solutions come to life and finally ensuring customer and business success.

This is a senior, hands-on product role that blends execution excellence with strategic influence. You will also meet directly with customers in pre- and post-sale contexts and help Adobe scale and evolve Mix Modeler as a core part of the Adobe Analytics family of solutions.

Your work will directly influence how some of the largest brands measure the performance of their campaigns and how they allocate billions in media spend to drive growth.

It’s an exciting time to join the team. We are firmly in the incubation and growth stages of the product-set. Our culture is to build value quickly, learn, iterate, and repeat. Come help drive this vision!

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy & Execution

Own strategy, roadmap, and execution for one or more functional areas within Adobe Mix Modeler; starting with the AI Measurement capabilities as a focus area.

Set near- and mid-term product vision within your domains, identifying high-impact opportunities where AI can improve insight generation, usability, and decision support.

Drive execution end to end by writing clear, detailed product requirement documents (PRDs/RPDs), user stories, and supporting documentation.

Work closely with globally distributed engineering and data science teams to define scope, evaluate trade-offs, review technical approaches, and ensure high-quality delivery.

Balance speed and rigor—shipping “good” solutions quickly, learning from customer feedback, and iterating rapidly is essential. Waiting to discover what perfection looks like before executing may happen from time to time but is far less common in this role.

Define success metrics and evaluate post-launch performance to guide iteration and investment.

ML & AI Feature Development

Research, prototype, and incubate new ML/AI capabilities using a 0→1 mentality, starting with slim, focused customer value.

Translate complex modeling approaches into usable product experiences tailored to analysts, data scientist and marketer personas.

Partner with data science teams to shape novel modeling capabilities and build associated requirements, interpret outputs, and ensure transparency, explainability, and customer trust.

Collaborate deeply with design partners to create intuitive workflows that make complex analytics understandable and actionable.

Develop UX artifacts, mockups, and flows to clarify product intent and accelerate alignment with deep collaboration with the UX Design team.

Customer & Market Engagement

Work closely with product marketing, sales, customer success, and enablement teams to support positioning, launches, adoption, marketing collateral and enablement sessions.

Engage directly with prospective and existing customers to understand marketing measurement workflows, validate problems, and test early solutions and alter product roadmap as needed.

Participate in pre-sales conversations by articulating product capabilities, roadmap direction, and analytical concepts.

Provide post-sale consulting support to help customers successfully adopt new features and realize value.

Travel periodically to support customer engagements, internal planning, and cross-functional collaboration as needed.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

Act as a senior individual contributor and role model for how to operate effectively in a fast paced, AI driven product environment.

Raise the overall bar for product craft, requirement documentation quality, and collaboration within the team.

Coach and mentor various consulting teams so that there is a broad understanding of AMM and related measurement methodologies ensuring a scaled approach to customer support.

What You Need To Succeed

Required Experience

8+ years of product management experience building and delivering SaaS products.

Strong background in marketing analytics, marketing measurement, media measurement, experimentation; ad tech experience is highly preferred.

Hands-on experience researching, launching, and iterating on ML- or AI-powered product features.

Demonstrated ability to be a ‘player/coach’; balancing strategic ideation with execution-heavy ownership, including writing detailed requirements, producing mock-ups and driving delivery.

Experience driving globally distributed cross functional teams including leading morning/night calls as needed.

Proven success building 0→1 or incubated products with comfort operating in ambiguity with a strong bias toward action, learning, and iteration.

Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud products or large-scale enterprise SaaS environments a plus.

Domain & Product Skills 

Deep understanding of marketing measurement challenges and how insights are used by marketers, analysts, and executives.

Expertise with two or more of the following modeling concepts: Media Mix Modeling, Multi-Touch Attribution, Causal Inference, Incremental lift studies and experimentation

Ability to translate complex data, models, and technical concepts into clear requirements and intuitive user experiences.

Working knowledge of UX fundamentals, including the ability to create basic mockups, flows, or prototypes.

Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering with engineer, marketing and pre/post-sales teams.

The Gen AI Experience Engineering team is defining the future of intelligent workflows across Adobe Experience Cloud with the AI Assistant. The Opportunity: 

We’re looking for an AI/ML Engineer who is excited to build intelligent features using whatever approach solves the problem best. Some solutions will use LLMs and generative AI, some will rely on traditional ML, some will be heuristic or rules-based, and many will be hybrid systems that combine them. 

Your job is to evaluate the problem, choose the right approach, and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that improve user experiences. In this role, you’ll build models, design prompts, develop services, run evaluations, and ship features end-to-end. This is a hands-on applied engineering role with broad ownership, where you’ll work across modeling, service development, and lightweight ops. 

What You’ll Do: 

AI, ML & Hybrid Solution Development 

Build and iterate on solutions using the full spectrum of approaches: LLMs, classical ML, heuristics, rules engines, retrieval systems, or combinations thereof. 

Design, train, and evaluate classical ML models where appropriate, and integrate, fine-tune (via prompting or adapters), and evaluate partner-provided LLMs for generative AI, classification, search, and content understanding use cases 

Develop prompting strategies, multi-step prompt workflows, and agents that power interactive AI experiences. 

Build hybrid pipelines that combine deterministic logic with AI/ML components for predictable, reliable outcomes. 

Service & Feature Engineering 

Implement backend services and inference pipelines for the AI Assistant across Experience Cloud. 

Build RAG systems, model-serving layers, experimentation hooks, and scalable APIs. 

Partner with frontend engineers and product teams to turn concepts into shipped features. 

Evaluation, Data, and Light Ops 

Build automated evaluation pipelines to measure quality, safety, latency, and reliability. 

Prepare datasets for evaluation, fine-tuning, and experimentation. 

Deploy models and services using CI/CD, containers, and cloud workflows. 

Monitor performance and iterate quickly based on data and user signals. 

While this is not a dedicated ops role you should be able to own and operate your work end-to-end as projects require. 

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design and ML teams to explore new ideas and deliver customer-facing features. 

Help define best practices for AI/ML development, evaluation, and hybrid system design. 

Contribute to shared tools that accelerate experimentation and improve developer productivity. 

What You Bring: 

5+ years experience in machine learning, applied AI engineering, IR or full-stack intelligent feature development – prioritizing experience with core ML problem-solving, such as building/designing or debugging predictive models (over operational pipelines and monitoring) 

Hands-on experience with both LLM-based and traditional ML techniques, and the judgment to choose the right tool for the job. 

Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production services (Node, Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar). 

Ability to design evaluation frameworks, run experiments, and iterate rapidly. 

Comfortable owning features from prototype → production, including monitoring and optimization. 

Excellent communication and collaboration skills; thrives in environments with ambiguity and autonomy. 

Nice to Have 

Experience with hybrid LLM + deterministic systems, vector search, or orchestration tools. 

Knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud or other enterprise SaaS ecosystems. 

Contributions to open-source AI/ML tools, model-serving frameworks, or evaluation libraries. 

Prior startup or high-velocity product development experience.

The Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Product Success Engineering (PSE) team is seeking an innovative Director of Data Science & Engineering to build the data foundation, KPI frameworks, and predictive intelligence that power product adoption, customer health, platform performance, and operational efficiency.

This is a high-visibility, 0-to-1 leadership role responsible for unifying Adobe’s product usage data and delivering insights that transform how we measure customer value and drive product success.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Platform Engineers to architect scalable data systems, develop predictive models, and enable data-driven decision-making across Adobe’s AEP portfolio.

What You’ll Lead

Data Strategy & Architecture

Define and deliver the data science, analytics, and platform strategy for Product Success Engineering.

Build a unified data foundation and governance model across diverse data sources.

Evolve internal intelligence into customer-facing insights and dashboards.

Team Leadership

Build and grow a world-class 20+ person data organization.

Establish team structure, operating processes, and career development paths.

Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Field teams.

Data Platform & Engineering

Architect end-to-end data pipelines, cloud data warehouse solutions, and real-time and batch analytics.

Implement data quality, governance, privacy, and metadata standards.

Enable scalable BI, ML, experimentation, and self-service analytics capabilities.

Data Science & Analytics

Develop models for customer health, adoption forecasting, and expansion.

Build KPI frameworks for product usage, retention, platform performance, and operations.

Drive advanced analytics, including segmentation, funnel insights, causal analysis, and experimentation.

Business Intelligence & Insights

Deliver dashboards and executive reporting that influence product and business strategy.

Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

Why Join the Team

Lead a greenfield data organization shaping the future of customer success intelligence at Adobe.

Drive impact on product adoption, retention, and value realization across the AEP + Apps ecosystem.

Build high-visibility, high-impact capabilities with strong executive sponsorship.

Work with cutting-edge data, ML, and cloud technologies at enterprise scale.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 10+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or data engineering, including 5+ years in people leadership roles managing teams of 10+.

Proven 0-to-1 data leader with a track record of building data foundations, teams, and analytics capabilities from the ground up.

Deep technical proficiency across the modern data stack, including ETL/ELT, cloud data warehouses, dbt, Airflow, SQL, Python, ML frameworks, BI tools, and data governance.

Experience architecting large-scale, cloud-native data platforms, real-time and batch pipelines, and integrating diverse SaaS data sources (usage, clickstream, entitlements, cost, CRM, and support).

Strong background in B2B SaaS metrics, product analytics, customer lifecycle insights, and operating in high-growth, data-driven environments.

Executive-level communicator with the ability to influence senior leaders, translate analytics into business insights, and build trusted cross-functional partnerships.

Demonstrated success hiring and leading multidisciplinary data teams while scaling data maturity from foundational reporting to advanced analytics and predictive intelligence.

Adobe Experience Cloud | Gen AI Experience Engineering 

About the Team 

The Gen AI Experience Engineering team is defining the future of intelligent workflows across Adobe Experience Cloud with the AI Assistant. We operate like a startup within Adobe—fast, iterative, and customer-focused. Our mission is to build the intelligent systems, models, and services that power Adobe’s AI Assistant experience. 

The Opportunity 

We’re looking for an AI/ML Engineer who is excited to build intelligent features using whatever approach solves the problem best. 

Some solutions will use LLMs and generative AI, some will rely on traditional ML, some will be heuristic or rules-based, and many will be hybrid systems that combine them. 

Your job is to evaluate the problem, choose the right approach, and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that improve user experiences. 

In this role, you’ll build models, design prompts, develop services, run evaluations, and ship features end-to-end. This is a hands-on applied engineering role with broad ownership, where you’ll work across modeling, service development, and lightweight ops. 

What You’ll Do 

AI, ML & Hybrid Solution Development 

Build and iterate on solutions using the full spectrum of approaches: LLMs, classical ML, heuristics, rules engines, retrieval systems, or combinations thereof. 

Design, train, and evaluate classical ML models where appropriate, and integrate, fine-tune (via prompting or adapters), and evaluate partner-provided LLMs for generative AI, classification, search, and content understanding use cases 

Develop prompting strategies, multi-step prompt workflows, and agents that power interactive AI experiences. 

Build hybrid pipelines that combine deterministic logic with AI/ML components for predictable, reliable outcomes. 

Service & Feature Engineering 

Implement backend services and inference pipelines for the AI Assistant across Experience Cloud. 

Build RAG systems, model-serving layers, experimentation hooks, and scalable APIs. 

Partner with frontend engineers and product teams to turn concepts into shipped features. 

Evaluation, Data, and Light Ops 

Build automated evaluation pipelines to measure quality, safety, latency, and reliability. 

Prepare datasets for evaluation, fine-tuning, and experimentation. 

Deploy models and services using CI/CD, containers, and cloud workflows. 

Monitor performance and iterate quickly based on data and user signals. 

While this is not a dedicated ops role you should be able to own and operate your work end-to-end as projects require. 

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design and ML teams to explore new ideas and deliver customer-facing features. 

Help define best practices for AI/ML development, evaluation, and hybrid system design. 

Contribute to shared tools that accelerate experimentation and improve developer productivity. 

What You Bring 

5+ years experience in machine learning, applied AI engineering, IR or full-stack intelligent feature development – prioritizing experience with core ML problem-solving, such as building/designing or debugging predictive models (over operational pipelines and monitoring) 

Hands-on experience with both LLM-based and traditional ML techniques, and the judgment to choose the right tool for the job. 

Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production services (Node, Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar). 

Ability to design evaluation frameworks, run experiments, and iterate rapidly. 

Comfortable owning features from prototype → production, including monitoring and optimization. 

Excellent communication and collaboration skills; thrives in environments with ambiguity and autonomy. 

Nice to Have 

Experience with hybrid LLM + deterministic systems, vector search, or orchestration tools. 

Knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud or other enterprise SaaS ecosystems. 

Contributions to open-source AI/ML tools, model-serving frameworks, or evaluation libraries. 

Prior startup or high-velocity product development experience.

The Challenge

Adobe is seeking as UNIX Administrator with excellent technical, process and automation skills to be part of High-Performance Cloud Operations Team. As an Infrastructure Administrator, this person is responsible for the daily administration of Linux and Unix servers in a business application environment. This includes general system administration tasks, software and hardware support, system configuration, system monitoring. This person must have excellent Linux/Unix administration experience, with customer relation skills. Candidate should be able to work with business application administrators, helping fix their applications and guide them with standard methodologies. Candidate must be able to express thoughts clearly and capable of working in a team or as a sole contributor. Individual should be self-motivated with very good communication skills. Main point responsible for the overall operability, resiliency, performance, and capacity of owned production services.

What you’ll do

System Administration - This person would be responsible for the day-to-day administration of all Linux based servers. This includes monitoring the trouble ticket queue, system fix, hardware and software system changes, scripting, patching, system performance monitoring, system sizing, system integration, upgrade implementation, and hardware diagnostics.

Application support – This person would work with application administrators to help fix and fine-tune applications and also if required guide application administrators in standard processes related to using the underlying UNIX infrastructure.

Documentation – Maintain all system documentation.

What you need to succeed

Unix/Linux System Administration: In-depth experience with Unix/Linux servers (especially RHEL, CentOS, SUSE) for installation, configuration, patching, and solve.

Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in scripting (Bash, Python) and automation tools (Ansible, etc.) to streamline deployments and manage configurations.

Demonstrable ability to perform UNIX builds such as RHEL

Networking Knowledge: Solid grasp of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, SSH, etc.) and system connectivity for effective solve in distributed environments.

Working knowledge of Virtual machine management (VmWare, OpenShift) TCP/IP functionality, networking, Remote administration, cloning, migration, etc.

Security Best Practices: Expertise in system security – user access controls, OS hardening, patch management, and compliance.

Soft Skills: Good communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills to collaborate across teams and resolve complex issues efficiently.

Operational experience with Ansible and Terraform are beneficial.

The opportunity 

We are looking for a Staff Program Manager to join our team and provide immediate impact to the Document Cloud design team within the broader Adobe Design team. In this role, your primary responsibilities include leading complex, multi-disciplinary programs and operationalizing design processes, including owning management tools, building alignment, and prioritizing work to ensure timelines and business objectives are met. Success in this role requires the ability to establish relationships and build rapport across teams, as well as to negotiate and influence cross-functional teams and leadership effectively. A successful Staff Design Program Manager demonstrates deep application/platform and design knowledge in combination with business and project management domain expertise to drive successful programs. 

What you’ll do 

Lead : Foster cross-functional partnerships with product managers, engineering leads, and design leadership to ensure alignment and effective collaboration. Advocate for design excellence, streamline priorities, and drive consensus across teams. 

Strategize: Break down complex initiatives into manageable phases and align team members on priorities. Translate high-level goals into actionable, structured plans that advance initiatives in a dynamic environment. 

Communicate Thoughtfully: Confidently convey program plans and design strategies using strong written, verbal, and presentation skills. Share standards to improve program execution and foster alignment across the design organization.

Drive Operational Excellence: Launch and manage initiatives to improve design operations, including creative workflows, schedules, and task assignments. Implement operational changes to optimize efficiency for designers.

Build Relationships: Cultivate strong connections with design managers, designers, program managers, researchers, and cross-functional partners to promote collaboration.

Collaborate on Project Decisions: Partner with design leadership on key project decisions, including requirements gathering, scheduling, resource allocation, and approvals.

Integrate Products and Manage Risks: Support partners in integrating Adobe products more closely. Manage program risks, communicate progress and dependencies, and provide updates to executives and business partners.

Adapt and Evolve Tactics: Understand and address the needs of partner organizations (PM, PMM, Engineering PgM, and Engineering) and adjust design operational tactics as needed to ensure positive, collaborative relationships.

Maintain Shared Resources: Contribute to shared design resources and manage team documentation, including team sites, status updates, and centralized resources.

Monitor Team Morale: Keep a pulse on team morale, raise risks to leadership, and find opportunities for improvement. 

What you need to succeed 

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 

15+ years of applicable experience in a design and technology environment. 

Demonstrated delivery of large-scale programs and projects. 

Strong verbal, presentation, and written communication skills. 

Strong conflict resolution and negotiation skills with the ability to lead in an environment of ambiguity with a diverse range of partners. 

Experience working with a large internal design team, including product design, user research, content design, design operations, and the overall product design process. 

Ability to help plan design resourcing needs and map out quarterly priorities in partnership with design leadership. 

Ability to establish relationships, build rapport, and influence cross-functional teams and leadership. 

A passion to have an influential role with the product team as a driver for design process and product strategy, communicating design ideas persuasively and concisely to all functions of the organization, including executives. 

Ability to distinguish critical from non-critical issues and set teams focus and priorities accordingly. 

The ability to break down issues to key fundamentals and drive the team toward action. 

Ability to partner with design leadership to brainstorm ideas for team collaboration and relationship building events. 

An ability to organize cross-functional activities into a complete plan, recognizing interdependence, and establishing a framework for the team to build out the plan and mentoring the execution of that plan. 

Ability to coach others and champion member value. 

Ability to handle ambiguity, set goals and effectively deliver to them if project plans shift and need to adapt. 

A love for fun while getting things done! We have a strong culture of collaboration that embraces sharing opinions but always underscored by kindness.

The Opportunity 

The Corporate Strategy team works closely with Adobe’s top executives and our three business units (the Creative Cloud, Document Cloud and Experience Cloud) to ensure that the company stays on its fast growth trajectory. We have played an active role in some of Adobe’s boldest and most strategic decisions, such as its well-publicized transition to cloud, and its expansion into a leadership position in Digital Marketing, and Adobe's positioning in the market around Generative AI. 

Today, Adobe is at the forefront of digital experiences worldwide – be it by giving creatives everything they need to design amazing new content, or by enabling global enterprises in their digital transformation and the creation of experience businesses. What you'll do 

As an Associate, you will join a highly entrepreneurial team, including alumni from a management consulting firms and experts in digital media and marketing. 2-4 years of experience at a management consulting firm or within an equivalent corporate strategy group

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) enables businesses to deliver the right experience at the right time to their customers. The Segmentation Service is one of the key AEP services, providing the ability to define customer segments and generate target audiences based on real-time customer profiles. Customer segment definitions are sophisticated queries over profile and event data capturing specific attributes or behaviors shared by a subset of users. With the need to perform trillions of audience segment evaluations per day, scalability and efficiency are paramount in segment evaluation. This is a great opportunity for engineers to solve extremely interesting challenges of scale and build core services that are used by all Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration solutions. As part of building these services, you will work with an exceptionally talented and collaborative team, tackle complex query evaluation challenges, design & implement innovative algorithms and build highly performant services.

***Looking for experienced individuals with 10+ yrs of SAAS experience

What you'll Do

Collaborate with a team of engineers & product managers in building a high-performance segmentation engine. Own responsibility for design and implementation of key components

Develop query compilation algorithms that transform and rewrite segment definition queries

Develop query optimization and evaluation algorithms including multi-query optimization, incremental evaluation and streaming evaluation

Work on cross functional themes involving advanced data pipelines using Apache Spark

Build tools to monitor query performance and identify & debug potential semantic errors

Deploy production services and iteratively improve them based on customer feedback

Follow Agile methodologies using industry leading CI/CD pipelines

Participate in architecture, design & code reviews

What you need to succeed

B.S. in Computer Science or a related field is required OR M.S. in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent practical experience is preferred

Experience building a scalable query engine or equivalent practical experience is required. Experience in language design is a plus

Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures

Proficiency in Databases or compilers is preferred

Strong programming skills with extensive experience in Java or Scala

Proficiency in Apache Spark is preferred.

Leadership skills to collaborate and drive cross-team efforts

Excellent communication skills

Adaptable to evolving priorities, accepting challenges outside one's comfort zone, learning new technologies, and delivering viable solutions within defined time boundaries

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Principal Engineer to join the GenStudio Engineering team. This role is ideal for a technical leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building scalable, high-impact software solutions. You will drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and influence the technical direction of GenStudio.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, test, and maintain AI/ML-based systems and applications that serve as the backbone of scalable, production-ready technology stacks.

Frame product features as ML tasks (e.g., classification, recommendation, context engineering).

Analyze trade-offs across cost, latency, and accuracy while ensuring compliance with UX, privacy, legal, and security constraints.

Assess data distribution (variance, sampling, drift) and manage data labeling workflows involving LLMs, SMEs, or user-generated activity.

Organize datasets for training, validation, and testing, and engineer high-quality features using normalization, smoothing, and weighting techniques.

Implement and adapt techniques from academic research and industry papers; evaluate algorithmic trade-offs considering data requirements, latency, and runtime.

Handle cold-start scenarios and mitigate overfitting/underfitting challenges.

Define offline benchmarks and metrics; design and analyze A/B tests to validate online performance.

Architect scalable ML systems (e.g., multi-agent, recommender, active learning, multi-stage model training, enterprise search) for both offline and online workflows.

Optimize model development and deployment in GPU/TPU environments using PyTorch.

Work cross-functionally with data, research, and product teams to translate models into production-ready services.

14+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record of technical leadership.

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Proven expertise in Machine Learning and Deep Learning, including model design, optimization, and fine-tuning.

Strong understanding of transfer learning principles and their application in production settings.

Proficiency in Python (especially for data workflows) and experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, CUDA, Hugging Face, and JAX.

Experience designing and deploying scalable AI/ML systems optimized for GPU/TPU environments.

Solid grasp of data engineering concepts—including dataset management, feature engineering, and handling data drift.

Ability to balance theoretical ML knowledge with practical, high-performance implementation.

Strong understanding of how to transform models into reliable, production-grade services.

Preferred Attributes

Recognized as a thought leader within and beyond the organization.

Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.

Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and evangelize new technologies.

Experience with building GenAI-first applications.

Contributions to industry forums, conferences, or open-source communities.

Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) enables businesses to deliver the right experience at the right time to their customers. The Segmentation Service is one of the key AEP services, providing the ability to define customer segments and generate target audiences based on real-time customer profiles. Customer segment definitions are sophisticated queries over profile and event data capturing specific attributes or behaviors shared by a subset of users. With the need to perform trillions of audience segment evaluations per day, scalability and efficiency are paramount in segment evaluation. This is a great opportunity for engineers to solve extremely interesting challenges of scale and build core services that are used by all Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration solutions. As part of building these services, you will work with an exceptionally talented and collaborative team, tackle complex query evaluation challenges, design & implement innovative algorithms and build highly performant services.

What you'll Do

• Contribute to query engine implementations that evaluates complex customer segment definitions efficiently

• Develop query compilation algorithms that transform and rewrite customer segment definition queries

• Develop query optimization and evaluation algorithms including multi-query optimization, incremental evaluation and streaming evaluation

• Build tools to monitor query performance and identify & debug potential semantic errors

• Collaborate with a team of engineers & product managers in building a high-performance query engine.

• Follow Agile methodologies using industry leading CI/CD pipelines

• Participate in architecture, design & code reviews

What you need to succeed

• B.S. in Computer Science or a related field is required

• M.S. OR Phd in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent practical experience is preferred

• Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures

• Excellent knowledge of Java and or Scala

• Proficiency in Databases or compilers is a plus.

• Working knowledge of query optimization techniques

About the Role 

 

The Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Product Success Engineering (PSE) team is seeking an innovative Director of Software Engineering & Applied AI to lead the development of AI agents, tooling, and automation to help customers directly support, operate, and scale their end-to-end AEP and Apps implementation. Your work will help fundamentally transform how we serve, support, and accelerate time-to-value for our customers by empowering them directly with engineering best practices. 
 
As the engineering leader, you will be responsible for the design and development of Agentic-first solutions that span across core customer success domains: 

Troubleshooting & Support - Solve AEP customer support issues through intelligent diagnosis, deflection, and resolution systems that leverage AI agents for automated issue diagnosis, intelligent ticket creation/routing, and self-service troubleshooting capabilities 

Run & Operate - Proactively monitor, remediate, and scale AEP in adherence to implementation best practices to prevent support issues through automated remediation workflows, performance optimization agents, and predictive scaling mechanisms that maintain AEP customer-specific implementation reliability 

Adoption & Value - Advise, accelerate, and grow AEP customer adoption and value realization through customer journey intelligence systems, use case & feature adoption recommendations, and usage pattern analysis tools 
 

In this role, you will collaborate with other members of our multidisciplinary team, including solution architects and data scientists, to build scalable systems that transform and establish our commitment to setting new industry benchmarks for product success engineering while driving measurable business impact and improved customer outcomes. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

 

Strategic Leadership & Vision 

Define and execute the technical strategy for AI-powered customer success solutions across Adobe's AEP portfolio, aligning engineering initiatives with business objectives and customer outcomes 

Lead the design and development of agentic AI systems that autonomously diagnose, prevent, and resolve customer issues while accelerating adoption and value realization 
 

Team Management & Organizational Development 

Build, mentor, and scale a world-class multidisciplinary engineering team of 15-25+ engineers, data scientists, and solution architects, fostering a culture of innovation, customer obsession, and technical excellence 

Collaborate effectively across multiple vertically aligned engineering teams, product management, UX design, and field organizations to ensure seamless integration of customer success solutions into AEP 
 

Product & Technical Execution 

Oversee the end-to-end development lifecycle of intelligent automation systems, AI agents, and customer intelligence platforms that transform reactive support into proactive, data-driven customer success operations 

Drive the implementation of customer-facing analytics, predictive insights, and recommendation engines embedded directly into AEP's user experience to enable self-service optimization 
 

Customer Success Engineering Innovation 

Champion the development of scalable automation solutions targeting 85%+ first contact resolution rates, 99.9%+ platform uptime, and measurable customer health score improvements 

Establish engineering best practices for AI model deployment, system reliability, and operational excellence while ensuring compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory standards 
 

Cross-Functional Partnership & Influence 

Serve as the technical voice of customer success engineering in executive forums, translating complex technical concepts into business impact and strategic initiatives 

Partner closely with Forward Deployment Engineers, Field Support Consultants, and Customer Success Managers to understand customer challenges and translate them into scalable engineering solutions 

 

Required Qualifications 

 

Educational Foundation & Core Experience 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, with 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in engineering leadership roles managing teams of 10+ engineers 

Demonstrated expertise in Applied AI/ML with 3-5 years of hands-on experience deploying production AI systems, including deep understanding of LLMs, generative AI, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures 
 

Technical Leadership & Architecture 

Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, cloud-native platforms and distributed systems, with expertise in microservices, API design, and enterprise integration patterns 

Strong background in customer intelligence platforms, analytics systems, and data pipeline architecture, with experience building real-time decision engines and predictive modeling systems 

Product and growth mindset, with a strong ability to translate customer challenges into scalable, automated solutions that drive adoption and business impact 
 

Customer Success & B2B SaaS Expertise 

Deep understanding of B2B SaaS customer success methodologies, including customer health scoring, churn prediction, adoption analytics, and expansion revenue optimization 

Experience leading customer-facing engineering teams or technical account management organizations, with demonstrated ability to translate customer feedback into product improvements 
 

Leadership & Communication 

Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, present to executive leadership, and drive alignment across diverse technical and business teams 

Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent while fostering inclusive, high-performance team cultures focused on customer outcomes

Experience embedding self-service BI, AI-powered recommendations, and workflow automation into enterprise SaaS products 

Knowledge of customer engagement strategies, marketing automation, and digital adoption platforms

The Challenge

Adobe established a Global Payments function in 2020, building teams across four key areas:

1. Partnership Management

2. Payments Strategy

3. Risk Decisioning

4. Payment Operations

Each team is centralized in the United States with a global remit. To enhance the strategic potential of our Payments business, Adobe is seeking an experienced regional leader to complement these central teams.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in LATAM payment processing, particularly in card-not-present and subscription payment models, along with strategies to optimize payment approval rates.

In this role, you will partner directly with the heads of central payment functions and the LATAM regional sales team, while collaborating with Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Product teams. Externally, you will engage with processors, acquirers, issuers, and alternative payment providers to deliver a “best-in-class” payments experience. This position requires big-picture thinking, prioritization of high-value opportunities, and innovative problem-solving to drive critical metrics focused on increasing Annual Recurring Revenue.

Responsibilities

Build and strengthen Adobe’s relationships with LATAM payment processors and major card networks (Visa, MasterCard, Amex, Carte Bancaires).

Develop strategic partnerships with alternative payment providers to enhance regional and country-specific customer experiences.

Establish relationships with top issuing banks in key LATAM markets, educate them on Adobe products, collaborate on payment optimization strategies, and complete co-marketing initiatives to drive demand.

Serve as the primary liaison between Adobe’s Payments organization and the LATAM sales team, ensuring alignment on strategies impacting payment approvals and declines.

Influence prioritization of payment initiatives on internal and partner roadmaps. Own trade-offs related to build time, feature functionality, and revenue return on investment. Post-launch, lead A/B testing, target measurement, and continuous improvement.

Create reporting and insights to track LATAM payment success trends and strategies driving revenue growth.

Stay ahead of LATAM payment industry trends and regulatory changes, identifying new opportunities and building business use cases for prioritization.

Foster a collaborative team culture focused on cross-functional alignment and data-driven decision-making.

Requirements

15+ years of payments experience, ideally in merchant processing—either with a payment processor, acquiring bank, or managing global e-commerce payments on the merchant side. Experience with issuing banks or global networks is a plus.

Proven ability to lead through influence and get results across LATAM Sales, Product, Treasury, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.

Deep understanding of the LATAM digital payment ecosystem, including trends, regulatory changes, and challenges in card-not-present recurring payments.

Highly self-motivated with the ability to deliver results independently.

Strong communication skills to simplify complex payment concepts and confidently engage senior leaders at banks, networks, and processors.

Ability to build accurate financial models and business usecases that support fast, fact-based decision-making.

BA/BS or equivalent experience required; MBA preferred.

Adobe is redefining customer intelligence. We help enterprises understand their customers deeply—what they value, what they need—and translate that understanding into meaningful, personalized experiences.

Our next chapter focuses on agent-driven AI systems—autonomous, adaptive agents that orchestrate complex workflows, learn from data, and deliver real-time insights and actions.

At the core lies our Enterprise Knowledge Base, a foundational platform that unifies structured, unstructured, and semi-structured data. This system fuels advanced AI and Generative AI applications across Adobe’s digital marketing ecosystem—empowering customers to unlock richer, more intelligent experiences.

We are looking for someone who thrives on solving hard problems, scaling intelligent systems, and creating measurable impact. You’ll lead the design and development of low-latency, high-throughput services that power intelligent enterprise experiences across millions of users worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Lead the technical design, implementation, and evolution of AEP Knowledge Base and Agentic AI systems.

Strong background in distributed storage (Delta Lake, Iceberg), compute (Spark), data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and cloud services (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Work hands-on with foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Gemini) and model adaptation techniques.

Architect RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and optimize vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus) for enterprise-grade AI solutions.

Experience with foundation models (OpenAI/Anthropic/Llama/Gemini) and model adaptation techniques.

Design and deploy high-performance, low-latency distributed systems that scale globally.

Establish guidelines for evaluation, safety, and guardrails for system behaviour.

Collaborate with research and product teams to integrate modern capabilities into the Platform.

Mentor engineers, drive technical excellence, and foster a culture of continuous learning.

Contributions to open-source projects in the agent/LLM ecosystem is desirable.

What you will need to succeed

15+ years in design and development of large scale data intensive distributed systems.

3+ years as a lead / chief architect.

In depth work experience on technologies like Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Snowflake, Kubernetes, etc.

In depth work experience on one or more public clouds like Azure, AWS or GCP.

Strong background in Relational Stores (PostgreSQL, MySQL).

Strong experience in Vector Stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).

Strong coding skills in Java, Scala, Python.

Proficiency in data structures and algorithms.

Cost consciousness around computation and memory requirements.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with multi-functional R&D teams.

BTech/MTech/MS in Computer Science, AI/ML or related fields.

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a bold, strategic leader to define and scale our global strategy for the Technology sector. This role spans software, hardware, semiconductor, electronics, cloud and platform companies, Professional Services, and Agency Networks, often with complex B2B, B2C and B2B2C value chains. 

As the Global Industry Strategy Lead, Technology, you will define Adobe’s industry point-of-view (POV) and translate it into a globally aligned, cross-cloud (Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration + Adobe Creativity & Productivity) go-to-market (GTM) strategy. You will partner deeply across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, and Marketing to unify Adobe’s narrative, accelerate pipeline, and drive repeatable impact across regions. 

 

This role sits within the Digital Strategy Group (DSG) and plays a critical part in Adobe’s Global Industry Strategy team—responsible for shaping Adobe’s industry vision, value propositions, and high-impact strategic motions at scale. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Develop Adobe’s POV for the Future of Technology 

Lead the creation of a differentiated, forward-looking POV that demonstrates how Adobe enables transformation across the entire Technology customer and partner ecosystem. 
This includes: 

· Demonstrating value across product-led growth motions, partner ecosystems, B2B commerce models, cloud & platform engagement, and customer lifecycle experiences 

· Shaping strategic use cases across data, personalization, content supply chain modernization, global marketing operations, and unified measurement 

· Developing reusable global assets: frameworks, POVs, use-case libraries, playbooks, industry demos, and Bill of Materials (BOM) content for sales, DSG, and partners 

You will collaborate closely with strategists, technologists, data scientists, partner organizations, and field teams to define what “great” looks like—and how Adobe helps Technology companies get there. 

 

2. Sharpen and Coordinate a Global GTM Strategy 

Translate the industry POV into a globally aligned, high-impact GTM motion. 
You will: 

· Align strategy across sales plays, product requirements, partner motions, and regional needs 

· Ensure GTM motions scale globally—not tied to a single region, account list, or narrow set of priorities 

· Provide input to product and engineering teams around emerging trends, customer patterns, and required capabilities 

· Collaborate with partner teams to define joint assets, accelerators, and co-sell strategies 

This role ensures Adobe shows up to the Technology industry with one coordinated voice and one unified strategy. 

 

3. Drive Influence Through High-Leverage Thought Leadership 

Focus on fewer, more strategic deliverables that scale across the business. 
This includes: 

· Authoring frameworks, POVs, and industry narratives used across Adobe’s global ecosystem 

· Identifying where Adobe has a differentiated “right to win” in Technology 

· Codifying insights from customer work into reusable global assets, such as customer success stories 

· Monitoring industry trends to ensure Adobe stays ahead of market shifts, emerging business models, and new experience expectations 

The impact of your work will be measured by clarity, adoption, and influence—not volume. 

 

4. Engage Executives Strategically (primarily 1:many, and 1:1 for top priority accounts) 

Represent Adobe as a trusted advisor in Technology executive settings. 
You will: 

· Lead Adobe’s involvement in industry events, executive forums, and roundtables 

· Present compelling, strategic thought leadership to C-suite audiences 

· Support high-value pursuits, Customer Experience Center (CEC) briefings, and strategic account engagements 

· Sponsor and cultivate key customers, enabling case studies, customer keynotes, and repeatable stories of impact 

Your goal is to maximize industry influence at scale while supporting the strategic deals that matter most. 

 

5. Amplify Global Marketing and Upskill the Ecosystem 

Partner with global marketing and field teams to amplify Adobe’s Technology leadership. 

 
You will: 

· Shape global campaigns, messaging, and event strategies 

· Guide positioning for AI-driven innovation in Technology 

· Enable DSG, field teams, SCs, BDRs, and partners with reusable training, demos, and toolkits 

· Build a consistent global drumbeat of Adobe-led thought leadership 

This role turns Adobe’s Technology capabilities into a cohesive, globally recognized story. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

Success is defined by the clarity you create, the global alignment you drive, and the measurable impact on Adobe’s Technology business. 

Ideal candidates bring: 

· 10+ years of experience in the Technology sector (software, hardware, cloud, semiconductor, electronics, strategy consulting, or platform provider) 

· Deep understanding of digital transformation within Technology: customer data, AI/ML, personalization, content supply chain, omnichannel experiences, B2B engagement, product-led growth, and measurement 

· Proven success building and executing strategic transformation programs 

· Experience aligning GTM strategies across sales, product, and partner teams, ideally with global scope 

· Ability to distill complex topics into clear, scalable frameworks and POVs 

· Outstanding executive presence with extensive experience presenting to C-suite audiences 

· Excellent storytelling, narrative development, and written communication skills 

· Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to influence in matrixed environments 

· Comfort navigating ambiguity with an entrepreneurial, opportunity-driven mindset 

· Willingness to travel up to 40%

· Open to candidates in PST, MST and PST time zones, with a strong preference for PST

 

Why This Role Matters 

Technology is one of the most rapidly evolving industries in the world—shaped by AI, cloud-driven engagement, platform ecosystems, new monetization models, and a global focus on speed, scale, and customer-centricity. Adobe’s customers need a trusted guide who can help them reimagine digital experiences across this landscape. 

This role ensures Adobe shows up with clarity, leadership, and conviction—helping define the future of Technology digital experience and enabling both established leaders and emerging innovators.

Join our team as an Engineering Manager and help bring the power of Content Authenticity to Adobe products and the world through SDKs, UI toolkits and hosted services.
If you are excited by helping fulfill the basic right to know what the content we consume is, then this role is made for you. Lead and empower a team of accomplished engineers who are dedicated to delivering transparency, attribution, and provenance to all creators.
As an outstanding technologist you are driven to apply phenomenal tools, just enough process, and steadfast quality. Your primary responsibilities will be to lead a team of SRE engineers, while also getting your hands into the code. You’ll help ensure that our SDKs, services, and web applications have proper guardrails and that spinning up new services is straightforward.
This is an exceptional opportunity for profound impact within the news and creative industries, to lead versatile engineers, and to be at the forefront of the movement creating a more credible internet.
What You'll Do

Lead and develop an engineering team: you will guide and mentor a small, dedicated group of engineers throughout the entire development process, from research and technical design to security assessment, implementation, and delivery. You will ensure smooth handoffs and releases with internal partners.

Collaborate with product management and clients: you will work closely with product leadership, customers, and open-source developers to define and refine the roadmap, priorities, and schedule.

Make data-driven decisions: rely on a combination of data and your instincts to make informed decisions and drive progress. Balancing speed and quality will be instrumental.

Advocate for engineering excellence: you will champion engineering excellence, contributing to the architecture and high-level structure of our applications. Your depth of technical expertise will ensure that our products are built with high quality, developer experience, and scalability in mind.

Drive culture and process improvements: You will not only manage your team but also improvements across the entire engineering team. Your insights and experience will help shape engineering practices.

Actively participate in architectural discussions, proposing innovative solutions to complex technical challenges and driving consensus among stakeholders.

Develop and maintain infrastructure, alerts, etc that can be easily replicated via code

Ensure there is proper documentation so developers can build on top of proper runbooks, baseline metrics, etc.

Help ensure that as technologies change, our services update to match

What you need to succeed

To succeed in this role, the following skills and qualifications are crucial:

CS degree or related degree, or equivalent experience

Software engineering experience: 5 years or more of experience in software engineering is required.

Leadership experience: a minimum of 2 years of experience successfully leading a software engineering team.

Strong knowledge of infrastructure as code such as OpenTofu, Terraform, etc

Experience with container orchestration via Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD, and other similar tools

Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling such as Grafana, Cortex, Prometheus, Splunk, Sentry, New Relic

A record of developing, leading, coaching, and mentoring software engineers is vital. You can foster a positive environment, ensuring your team's professional development.

Pluses

Experience building on top of platforms to cater to team-specific needs

Experience with performance and UI testing via tools such as K6 and Playwright

Distributed team experience: you know how to work in a diverse team spread across different time zones but relish face-to-face time with your team when you have the opportunity.

Role Summary

The Director, Partner Co‑Innovation & Strategic Execution is a senior individual contributor accountable for advancing Adobe’s partner co‑innovation strategy through disciplined execution, operating model leadership, and executive‑level decision support. This role operates at the intersection of strategy and execution, translating complex partner opportunities into structured, scalable co‑innovation motions that drive early adoption, pipeline creation, and long‑term ecosystem impact.

With broad autonomy and significant influence, the Director owns critical components of the partner co‑innovation operating model and leads high‑visibility partner‑led solution initiatives with GSIs and agencies. The role is expected to operate independently in ambiguous environments, exercise sound judgment, and shape outcomes across multiple teams and stakeholders

Core Responsibilities

1. Strategic Ownership of the Partner Co‑Innovation Operating Model

Own and evolve core elements of Adobe’s partner co‑innovation operating model, ensuring clarity, consistency, and scalability across initiatives

Lead complex, multi‑party solution co‑creation efforts, aligning Adobe’s product and architectural capabilities with partner‑led solution strategies

Define solution success criteria, maturity models, milestones, and validation paths that support monetization and field readiness

Establish standards for solution documentation, readiness artifacts, and maturity checkpoints used across teams and leadership forums

2. Senior IC Leadership within Co‑Innovation Programs

Serve as a senior IC leader within the co‑innovation program, accountable for execution quality, momentum, and outcomes across priority initiatives

Own partner intake and progression mechanisms, including structured engagement through Joint Partnership Agreements

Ensure co‑innovation initiatives are aligned with field, industry, and revenue priorities to maximize downstream impact

Shape operating cadences, governance rhythms, and leadership‑ready narratives that enable informed decision‑making

3. Executive‑Level Execution and Governance Leadership

Lead development of executive‑level materials, insights, and recommendations for senior governance and strategic forums

Own tracking, synthesis, and interpretation of solution maturity, pipeline signals, and early impact indicators

Proactively identify risks, interdependencies, and execution gaps; drive resolution through influence and escalation as needed

Ensure partner‑led initiatives progress with predictability and discipline from incubation through early field enablement

4. Enable Scale and Ecosystem Transition

Lead transition planning for matured partner solutions into scaled ecosystem programs and repeatable field motions

Drive development of solution playbooks, GTM narratives, and enablement assets in partnership with cross‑functional teams

Synthesize partner, field, and internal feedback into actionable improvements to operating models and solution motions

Build and maintain trusted, senior‑level relationships across partners and internal stakeholders to sustain momentum and alignment

Key Stakeholders

Global System Integrators and Agency Partners

Partner Sales, Revenue, and Operations

Finance, DSG, Field Sales, and Solutions

Industry Teams, Marketing, and Thought Leadership

Senior and Executive Stakeholders involved in governance and strategic alignment

Success Metrics

Effectiveness and adoption of partner co‑innovation frameworks, documentation, and governance mechanisms

Predictability, throughput, and quality of partner‑led co‑innovation initiatives

Executive confidence in insights, recommendations, and program health

Early pipeline creation, solution adoption, and field readiness outcomes

Sustained positive feedback from senior partners and internal stakeholders

Experience & Qualifications

Required

~12+ years of experience in partnerships, strategy, program leadership, consulting, or enterprise technology environments

Demonstrated success operating as a senior individual contributor driving complex, cross‑functional initiatives

Deep experience working with GSIs or agencies on solution development, transformation, or GTM efforts

Strong executive communication skills and experience supporting senior‑level decision‑making

Proven ability to create structure, clarity, and momentum in ambiguous environments

Preferred

Background in SaaS, enterprise platforms, or partner‑driven growth models

Experience in consulting, transformation programs, or PMO leadership contexts

Exposure to front‑office transformation, digital experience platforms, martech, or data‑driven solutions

Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes without formal authority

Capabilities & Behaviors

Executive‑level written and verbal communication

Strong judgment, prioritization, and operational rigor

Ability to translate strategy into scalable operating models

Collaborative, systems‑oriented thinker

Comfort operating across strategic and executional altitudes

What Success Looks Like

Partner co‑innovation initiatives progress smoothly through defined milestones

Partners experience clarity, accountability, and confidence in engagement

Executives receive crisp, decision‑ready insights

Field teams are equipped with adoption‑ready materials

Partner‑led solutions contribute measurable early‑stage pipeline and revenue impact

Role Summary 

We are seeking a PMO lead to oversee a complex, multiyear, multi workstream strategic partnership involving co-innovation, solution development, services delivery, product integration, and coordinated GTM activation. 

This role serves as the central program leader responsible for ensuring operational rigor, workstream discipline, cross functional synchronization, structured governance, and predictable execution across all partnership activities. The PMO Lead ensures that all workstream sponsors follow through on their commitments, business cases, and delivery milestones while also coordinating closely with internal functions such as legal, sourcing, finance, product, engineering, partner marketing, and field teams. 

This is a high visibility role that requires exceptional program leadership, strong commercial acumen, and experience orchestrating complex crossfunctional initiatives in fast moving environments. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Governance & Operating Cadence 

Own and operate the end-to-end governance model across all participating organizations. 

Establish and run structured partnership cadences, including monthly, quarterly, and executive level reviews. 

Manage issue and risk escalation processes across workstream, program, and executive levels. 

Maintain clear and consistent communication loops between workstream owners, alliance management, executive sponsors, and technical leadership. 

Establish and maintain a structured PMO operating model aligned to multi-year strategic investments. 

2. Workstream Oversight 

Oversee execution quality and pacing across all defined workstreams, which may include areas such as presales support, value realization, consulting delivery, product integration, GTM enablement, and innovation programs. 

Ensure each workstream maintains clear deliverables, KPIs, milestones, risks, business case assumptions, and success measurements. 

Track progress across all workstreams through standardized dashboards, status reviews, and structured accountability mechanisms. 

3. SOW Development, Contracting & Compliance

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Administrative Assistant who treats executive calendar and operations management as a craft. You will support two senior leaders in Adobe’s GenStudio organization — a high-growth, GenAI-powered product area.

The executives you support run cross-functional product or marketing organizations with heavy inbound meeting demand from engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer stakeholders. The right candidate understands business context well enough to make real-time prioritization decisions about what gets calendar time and what doesn’t — without being told.

You will also serve as an operational anchor for executives who move fast and get pulled in many directions simultaneously. That means keeping them on schedule, reminding them what’s next, flagging when they’re about to miss a commitment, and maintaining composure when priorities shift rapidly throughout the day.

What Sets You Apart

You understand the business, not just the calendar. You learn the executive’s priorities, stakeholder map, and active workstreams so you can make smart scheduling decisions autonomously. When an executive requests time, you know whether it’s urgent or can wait — and you act accordingly.

You own outcomes, not tasks. You don’t wait to be told a conflict exists — you surface it and propose a solution before the executive notices.

You keep pace under pressure. When priorities shift three times before lunch, you stay calm, reprioritize, and communicate changes clearly. You thrive in high-tempo environments and don’t freeze when things move fast.

You keep the executive accountable. You are comfortable telling the executive what needs to happen next, pulling them out of a meeting that’s running over, and reminding them of commitments they’ve lost track of. You see yourself as an operational partner, not a support function.

You build systems, not workarounds. Repeating processes frustrate you. You build templates, standing blocks, and protocols that prevent problems from recurring.
 

What You Will Own

Calendar Strategy & Prioritization (Primary)

Business-context-driven scheduling: Understand the executive’s priorities, active workstreams, and stakeholder landscape well enough to make informed decisions about which meetings to accept, decline, or reschedule — without requiring executive input on every request.

Proactive conflict resolution: Own the end-to-end executive calendar across Outlook. Identify and resolve conflicts before they surface — daily, not weekly. When inbound demand is high, triage based on urgency and business impact.

Stakeholder coordination: Schedule and reschedule across cross-functional leadership, external partners, and direct reports with clear communication to all affected parties.

Weekly reconciliation: Maintain a standing weekly sync with each executive to align priorities, flag upcoming conflicts, and confirm the next week’s schedule.

Meeting hygiene: Ensure every calendar invite includes agendas, prep materials, and correct attendees. Decline or defer low-priority requests on behalf of executives.
 

Executive Time Management & Pacing

Keep the executive on track: Proactively remind the executive of upcoming meetings, hard stops, and commitments throughout the day. When the executive gets pulled into unplanned conversations or runs over, you are the one who brings them back on schedule.

Protect focus time: Build and defend blocks for deep work, prep time, and flows across meetings. Push back on requests that erode these blocks without a strong business reason.

Surface what needs attention: Flag overdue action items, approaching deadlines, and commitments the executive may have lost visibility on.

Meeting Preparation & Follow-Up

Prepare briefing documents and context materials ahead of leadership reviews and external meetings.

Track recurring commitments (QBRs, planning cycles, leadership reviews) and proactively build them into the calendar.

Travel & Expenses

Coordinate domestic and international business travel end-to-end: flights, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries.

Submit and reconcile expense reports in a timely manner, flagging any policy questions proactively.

Team Events & Operations

Plan and implement team offsites, all-hands meetings, team-building activities, and cross-functional events.

Coordinate space planning, floor moves, and team logistics as needed.

Provide on-site support at Adobe events and conferences (occasional travel required).

Cross-Functional EA Coordination

Build strong relationships with EAs across Adobe to facilitate cross-org scheduling.

Provide backup coverage during PTO, illness, or sabbatical for peer EAs.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of experience supporting Sr. Director-level or above executives in a fast-paced technology company.

Expert-level calendar management in Outlook, including multi-executive scheduling across time zones and high-volume inbound meeting requests.

Demonstrated ability to learn business context quickly and use it to make independent scheduling and prioritization decisions.

Proven composure and effectiveness under pressure — comfortable with rapid priority shifts and frequent interruptions throughout the day.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of clear, proactive communication.

Proficiency with Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, and standard enterprise productivity tools.

Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.
 

Preferred

Experience supporting product or engineering leadership in a SaaS or enterprise software company.

Track record of building or improving operational processes for executive support.

Familiarity with Adobe tools and internal systems.

BA/BS degree (equivalent experience may substitute).

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Program Manager, EWX Transformation to support high-impact initiatives that shape the future of employee experience at Adobe.

In this role, you’ll join the Office of Transformation within the Employee & Workplace Experience (EWX) organization—an energized team of strategists, process/service designers, and change leaders who love solving complex challenges. You’ll focus on program management for large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that modernize how we deliver HR and Workplace services, improve how employees receive support, and help EWX drive measurable outcomes for the business.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to learn, grow, and make an impact—working closely with leaders and project teams while building strong program muscles across planning, execution, team alignment, and change enablement.

What you’ll do

Program Management for Special Projects: Support end-to-end delivery of transformation initiatives and special projects—helping teams establish clear scope, plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and success measures.

Execution & Operating Rhythm: Drive program operating cadence (project plans, action tracking, decision logs, RAID, and status reporting) to ensure progress, remove blockers, and maintain momentum across workstreams.

Cross-functional Coordination: Partner with global and regional Employee Experience teams, IT, Legal, Finance, and other collaborators to align on goals, timelines, and deliverables—ensuring smooth execution across geographies.

Portfolio Support: Contribute to portfolio visibility by supporting intake, prioritization discussions, resourcing conversations, and ongoing progress tracking for the transformation roadmap.

Change & Enablement Support: Help build and coordinate change, communication, and training plans that enable adoption of new services, processes, and tools. Support learning strategies that build new capabilities and ways of working (including AI fluency).

Continuous Improvement & Insights: Collect feedback, synthesize insights, and help teams translate data into actions—improving program delivery, stakeholder experience, and measurable outcomes.

Program Storytelling: Create crisp, executive-ready updates that simplify complexity, communicate progress, and highlight key decisions needed to keep initiatives on track.

What you need to succeed

5+ years of experience in program management, business operations, consulting, or related roles in a global, matrixed organization.

Demonstrated ability to manage large, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines.

Strong fundamentals in program/project management, including planning, documentation, RAID management, executive status reporting, and facilitation.

Confidence working with ambiguity—able to break down complex problems into structured plans and drive next steps.

Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills; able to tailor messaging for different audiences.

Interest in transformation work across employee experience, HR services, operations, and process improvement; familiarity with agile ways of working is a plus.

Experience with tools such as Workday, ServiceNow, Power BI, or similar platforms is a plus.

The Sales Transformation Portfolio Manager plays a critical role in orchestrating how sales transformation initiatives are evaluated, prioritized, governed, and communicated across the organization. This role ensures initiative intake is structured, data is accurate, progress is visible, and leadership has the insights needed to make informed decisions. The Portfolio Manager helps establish the operating rhythm, frameworks, and standards that enable the Sales Transformation Office to run effectively and scale as the portfolio grows.

This individual acts as the connective tissue across strategic programs, business leaders, and cross functional partners. They own the portfolio operating model, ensure data-driven decision-making, and provide transparency into initiative performance, value delivery, and risk areas. This role is ideal for someone who brings strong analytical, operational, and organizational experience with the ability to create clarity, structure, and insight in fast-moving environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Intake, Prioritization, and Planning

Manage the intake process for new sales transformation initiatives, ensuring clear scope, business case, and alignment to strategic objectives.

Develop and manage prioritization frameworks to determine sequencing, dependencies, and resource considerations across the portfolio.

Maintain an accurate, up-to-date source of truth portfolio view, capturing progress, risks, interdependencies, and value delivery.

Partner with leaders across sales, marketing, finance, operations, and product to ensure initiatives are properly defined and positioned for success.

Data Management and Insights

Own initiative data quality across systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness.

Create standard data structures, definitions, and reporting guidelines for use across the Transformation Office.

Define and maintain portfolio-level KPIs, value realization measures, and reporting logic.

Executive Dashboarding and Visibility

Develop and maintain executive dashboards that provide a clear view into progress, risks, trends, value delivery, and overall portfolio health.

Translate complex program data into meaningful insights for executive audiences.

Provide timely reporting to leadership, enabling informed decisions and proactive interventions.

Governance and Operating Rhythm

Establish and manage the governance framework used to monitor progress, escalate risks, and ensure accountability across initiatives.

Lead cross portfolio forums, including leadership reviews, operating cadences, and decision-making sessions.

Maintain consistent operating rhythms, guiding the organization through structured, predictable, and transparent review cycles.

Frameworks, Standards, and Tooling

Own the Transformation Office’s portfolio and program delivery standards, frameworks, templates, and methodologies.

Define and enforce consistent practices across initiative planning, reporting, and status management.

Evaluate, implement, and manage tooling to support portfolio management, reporting, and collaboration.

Partner with program leaders to ensure adoption and consistent application of standards and tools.

Cross Functional Partnership and Enablement

Partner closely with program managers and business leaders to maintain high-quality plans, data, and reporting.

Support initiative teams in following the Transformation Office framework and best practices.

Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and operational excellence across the transformation ecosystem.

Qualifications:

Required

8–12+ years of experience in portfolio management, PMO operations, transformation support, or strategic program management.

Proven experience managing cross-functional portfolios and creating prioritization or governance models.

Strong analytical skills with experience designing dashboards and communicating insights to executive audiences.

Ability to design and operationalize frameworks, standards, and scalable processes.

Demonstrated success bringing structure, clarity, and organization to complex, ambiguous environments.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex information.

Preferred

Experience within a Transformation Office, Enterprise PMO, or Strategy/Operations team.

Background supporting sales, go-to-market, or revenue-driving initiatives.

Familiarity with portfolio management or BI tools such as Smartsheet, Workfront, Tableau, or Power BI.

Experience in SaaS, technology, or consulting environments.

Key Competencies

Portfolio management and prioritization

Governance and operating model design

Data quality, metrics, and dashboarding

Executive reporting and storytelling

Cross-functional coordination

Process design and standardization

Analytical problem solving

Organizational clarity and structure

Why This Role Matters

This role is foundational to the effectiveness of the Sales Transformation Office. By owning intake, prioritization, governance, and portfolio visibility, the Portfolio Lead/Manager ensures the organization invests in the right initiatives and delivers measurable outcomes. This role provides the insights, structure, and operational discipline that empower leadership to make high-quality decisions and accelerate transformation across the business.
